title: Discharge and follow-up in noctune — iPhone
tagline: From discharge to the client's reply.

headline: Read the
discharge notes.
scenes.narration: This video covers discharge and follow-up on iPhone. Open the Discharge tab and read what the client will receive before you send anything.

headline: Choose how
replies work.
scenes.narration: Tap the send button to start an email, then tap the sender to choose a route. Every account can send a one-way email that the client can't reply to. With Nest, you can send through a private relay address. Replies then come back to the encounter. Nest also lets you send from your personal email. Here we cancel, so nothing is sent.

headline: Follow up in
Messages.
scenes.narration: Replies sent through Nest appear in the encounter's Messages tab, so the conversation stays with the visit.
